title: Prince William County data center zoning and Hornbaker Road evidence
jurisdiction: Prince William County, Virginia, United States

overlay_amendment.transition: The County describes five eligibility routes for land in the overlay as of September 21, 2026. The fifth requires acceptance of a qualifying filing for county quality-control review within 90 days after adoption.
overlay_amendment.overlay_boundary_note: The county states it will publish the revised boundaries after the final eligibility window. The GIS comparison is a dated layer observation.

overlay_gis.method: Compared polygons in EPSG:2283 after transforming the county GeoJSON from WGS84. Computed polygon intersection and minimum boundary distance. Converted US survey feet to meters.
overlay_gis.limits: Layer snapshot only. The setback or eligibility for a current proposal is not determined by distance to the layer. The case brief establishes a Board approval, not compliance with all conditions or a building permit.

separate_substation_case.name: Vint Hill Substation
separate_substation_case.scope: Independent case. No connection to Hornbaker Road is asserted.
